payload.workflow: Patient Search rule:fd66e16ee9; opd-reception merged identity and barcode lookup
payload.title: Search by a merged patient's old MRN returns no master patient
payload.actual: Fresh scenario8fe222 source10 MRN-2026-000006 was merged into master11 MRN-2026-000007 (confirmed200, patient.merged event118). Before merge, search by old MRN returned source10. After merge the same query returns200 data[]. Searching the master MRN returns11. GET /patients/10 retains source10/Merged with master_patient_id11 and merged_into_id11; master details list the merged identity. Observed real Electron UI and direct MCP API; no frontend result fabrication or identifier rewrite.
payload.expected: A returning patient's old MRN/barcode should resolve to the authoritative master exactly once, consistent with Patient Search rulefd66e16ee9 ('Merged records resolve to the master record automatically; never show merged duplicates as separate patients') and retained merged MRNs/history. If old identifiers are intentionally not supported, explicitly clarify the contract and supported safe lookup workflow; currently this prevents finding an existing merged patient by their old issued slip.
payload.steps: Use existing newly-created synthetic source10/master11; do NOT repeat the merge. As demo.reception GET /patients/10 confirms master11. GET /patients/search?q=MRN-2026-000006&limit=20 ->200/[]. GET /patients/search?q=MRN-2026-000007&limit=20 ->200/[patient11]. In Patient search scan old MRN+Enter: no match. This differs from open issue17: exact current MRNs work, only an old merged identifier is lost.
